collection.title: Mitsubishi Shogun 2009 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mitsubishi Shogun 2009 Onwards requires a 22" wiper blade the drivers side and a 20" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the Retorfit style wiper. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Mitsubishi Shogun which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
